description: Show interest in a DIRECT_SHIP (or any Active) Supply Opportunity for this farm. Writes a Pending farmInterest and opens a support ticket (same as SupplierPage). Requires farm AI key with supplier write role. Set confirm:true to commit.

confirm.description: Set true to persist; otherwise dry-run preview

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key to prevent duplicate interest

note.description: Optional note for the support ticket

name: express_supplier_interest
